packc compile flags: -c/--config (default config.arena.yaml), -o/--output (default <id>.pack.json), --id (default current folder name sanitized)
packc compile creates the output directory; compile-prompt does not
compile prints '✓ Pack compiled successfully' with prompt, tool, eval, workflow and agent counts
packc inspect prints pack info, prompts, fragments, workflow, agents, metadata, compilation
default id from current directory name via SanitizePackID; non-letter start gets pack- prefix
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error

packc compile-prompt flags -p/--prompt and -o/--output, both required
compile-prompt: id from task type (_ to -), name/version/description from prompt, no $schema
